fields.Name: T230 - Credentials Bulk Selection Actions Bar
fields.Description: Custom multi-select with a transaction-group-backed bulk activate/deactivate/delete UI unique to this list; the generic grid's bulk capability is add-to-list only.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Credentials', then open the 'Credentials' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Clear any filters so credentials are visible, then select two or more credentials using the card/row checkboxes. Verify a bulk actions bar appears showing the selected count, a 'Clear selection' link, and bulk buttons (Activate / Deactivate / Delete). Confirm 'Clear selection' dismisses the bar. If fewer than two credentials exist, confirming the selection checkboxes are present is acceptable. Do NOT actually delete anything.

judgeValidationCriteria: Selecting one or more credentials reveals a bulk actions bar with a live selected-count
The bar shows Activate / Deactivate / Delete buttons and a Clear selection link
Clicking Clear selection dismisses the bar (or, if <2 credentials exist, selection checkboxes are present)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
